name: Dialogue of the Elders
text: Dialogue of the Elders is a title under which some readers seek an early Irish text. The dictionary treats the title as a cross-reference. Readers looking for Dialogue of the Elders are sent to the Acallam na Senórach. Acallam na Senórach is the standard scholarly title. The English phrase Dialogue of the Elders is a loose translation. The Irish title names the tales told by the aged survivors of the Fianna. Cáilte mac Rónáin and Oisín are the chief speakers. The setting places the speakers in the centuries after the battle of Gabhair. Scholars treat Dialogue of the Elders as a useful English gloss. The proper entry is the Acallam.

okr.objective: Dialogue of the Elders as an English see-reference pointing to the Acallam na Senórach.
